claims.statement: Agostino Vespucci notes in a printed book that Leonardo is painting a portrait of Lisa del Giocondo. This note is the principal contemporary link to the Mona Lisa.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Marginal note in a volume of Cicero, Heidelberg University Library.
